
'''List of Kofun in the Japanese Archipelago with the Name "Hyō"''' (「瓢」の付く日本列島の古墳一覧)

This article provides a list of kofun (ancient Kofuns) and kofun clusters in the '''Japanese Archipelago''' whose names include '''"Hyō"''' (瓢 / ひさご), which refers to a '''gourd'''.

== Overview ==
Throughout '''Japan''', there are many kofun with names like '''"Hyōtan-zuka"''' (瓢箪塚 / ひょうたんづか, ひさごづか) and '''"Hyōtan-yama"''' (瓢箪山 / ひょうたんやま, ひさごやま). In addition, there are variations such as '''"Hyō-zuka"''' (瓢塚 / ひょうづか, ひさごづか), '''"Hisago-zuka"''', and '''"Hisago-yama"''', as well as names where '''"Hyō"''' is written in '''hiragana'''.  
These names are believed to originate from the resemblance of '''keyhole-shaped kofun''' ('''zenpō-kōen-fun''') or '''square-fronted kofun''' ('''zenpō-kōhō-fun''') to a '''gourd (瓢箪, hisago / hyōtan)''' when viewed from the side.

== {{ill|Hyōtan-yama Kofun|ja|瓢箪山古墳}} ==
* {{ill|Komaoka Hyōtan-yama Kofun|ja|駒岡瓢箪山古墳|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q119217988}} - Located in '''Tsurumi Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture''', part of the '''Komaka Kofun Cluster'''.
* {{ill|Hyōtan-yama Kofun (Kannami Town)|ja|瓢箪山古墳 (函南町)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q117337757}} - Located in '''Kannami Town, Tagata District, Shizuoka Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Moriyama Hyōtan-yama Kofun|ja|守山瓢箪山古墳|qid=DELETED_QID}} - Located in '''Moriyama Ward, Nagoya City, Aichi Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Azuchi-Hyōtanyama Kofun|en|Azuchi-Hyōtanyama Kofun|qid=Q11450459|lt=Azuchi Hyōtan-yama Kofun}} - Located in '''Ōmihachiman City, Shiga Prefecture'''.
* {{ill|Hyōtan-yama Kofun (Higashi-Osaka City)|ja|瓢箪山古墳 (東大阪市)}} - Located in '''Higashi-Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture''', part of the '''Yamahata Kofun Cluster'''.
* {{ill|Saki Hyōtanyama Kofun|en|Saki Hyōtanyama Kofun|qid=Q11383488|lt=Saki Hyōtan-yama Kofun}} - Located in '''Nara City, Nara Prefecture''', part of the '''Saki Tatenami Kofun Cluster'''.

* {{ill|Hisago-tsuka Kofun (Ebina)|ja|瓢箪塚古墳 (海老名市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q110814750}} - Located in '''Ebina City, Kanagawa Prefecture''', part of the '''Kamihamada Kofun Cluster'''.
* {{ill|Kodairazawa Kofun|ja|小平沢古墳|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11460737}} - Located in '''Kōfu City, Yamanashi Prefecture''', an alternate name for '''Kobirasawa Kofun'''.
